playstyle: The all-rounder. Wavu calls him an answer for every situation: strong punishes, space control, great lows and a parry. Poke with safe mids, flow into Zenshin (ZEN) for mix-ups, and use his Mishima tools (EWHF, crouch dash) to punish. His backdash cancel is sluggish, so rely on sidesteps and parries on defence.

stances.name: Zenshin
stances.entry: f+3+4 or b+3+4, and F after b+3 or f+4
stances.note: ZEN.2 is a homing power crush and Heat Engager; ZEN.u+1 tornadoes; ZEN.1 and ZEN.1,3 are his combo tools.

stances.name: Crouch Dash
stances.note: CD.df+1 tornadoes and evades jabs; in Heat it becomes the electric version (Wavu).
